title: Polymorphic shapes
prompt: Implement nested classes inside `Solution`: abstract `Shape` with `public abstract string Describe();`, plus `Circle(double radius)`, `Square(double side)`, and `Triangle(double a, double b, double c)` — each overriding `Describe()` to return exactly `"circle r=1"` / `"square s=2"` / `"triangle a=3 b=4 c=5"` style strings.

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: Each override formats its own kind — one call site, three behaviors.

tests.name: dispatch
tests.hint: Through a base-typed list, the actual type decides the output — that is the polymorphism contract.
